concepts.def: Participants must understand the study and agree to take part; presumptive consent used if deception is unavoidable.
Withholding information or misleading participants; permitted only if no alternative and harm is minimal.
Participants must be free to leave at any point without penalty, including withdrawing their data.
Participants must be protected from physical and psychological harm beyond everyday experience.
Full explanation after the study including its true aim and opportunity for participants to ask questions.
British Psychological Society Code of Ethics and Conduct sets four principles: respect, competence, responsibility, integrity.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Issues and Debates — a core area of A-Level Psychology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Issues and Debates brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Issues and Debates.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
